jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About  WithCoverage :

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

We partner with over one thousand high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.

Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us:

- Grow Faster – We’re scaling quickly, giving you significant opportunities to learn, lead, and shape your career and the company's future.

- Work That Matters – We protect the world’s most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.

- Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.

- Financial Rewards – We hire the best and invest in you. That means competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

About The Role:

As our Business Operations Lead, you will work directly with executive leadership and partner closely with Risk and Product to redesign how Risk Management is delivered. You will build the systems that determine how work flows through the organization, how teams are structured, and how performance is measured.

This is not a role where you hand off recommendations. You will own problems from diagnosis through implementation, starting with the details of how the work gets done, then deploying solutions across the organization.

What You’ll Do:

- Develop a deep, end-to-end understanding of how the Risk team operates - from client request through final output - including handoffs, bottlenecks, and differences across industries such as construction, consumer goods, and technology.

- Identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve quality, speed, and efficiency, then lead the work required to capture them.

- Define the metrics that reveal performance, capacity constraints, and operational breakdowns across the Risk organization.

- Build the reporting and capacity-planning systems used to inform hiring, resource allocation, and performance management across Risk pods.

- Design and continuously improve the standard operating procedures that guide the Risk team as our organization and technology evolve.

- Determine the right ownership model for critical workflows, including team structures, responsibilities, and new role profiles.

- Partner closely with Product to translate operational pain points into a prioritized roadmap for automation and technology investment.

Who You Are:

- You have 4+ years of experience in rigorous strategy and operations roles, such as management consulting and/or early stage operations.

- You are an exceptional structured problem solver who can build context quickly, form clear hypotheses, and use data to reach practical conclusions.

- You have high agency. You are comfortable defining the path forward when the problem is ambiguous and the information is incomplete.

- You combine systems thinking with a willingness to get into the details of workflows, data, and day-to-day execution.

- You are motivated by building solutions that work at 10x the current scale, not simply fixing the immediate problem.

- You can move independently from analysis to implementation while keeping senior leaders aligned.

- You communicate clearly and can influence teams across functions, even when you do not have formal authority.

For candidates based in the United States, the expected pay range for this position at the start of employment is $150,000 – $185,000/year. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as market location, job-related skills, experience, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for additional variable compensation, including quota-based incentives where applicable. WithCoverage offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package for full-time employees, which includes equity grants and a robust suite of benefits.

What We Offer:

- Competitive compensation that includes equity

- Comprehensive benefit plans for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

- Pre-tax accounts (FSA, HSAs, dependent care FSAs, commuter savings)

- Human Interest: 401(k) provider

- Time Off: Flexible time off, sick leave, family and medical leave, and major national holidays

- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture

This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us

- Grow Faster – We're scaling quickly, giving you real opportunities to lead, shape strategy, and accelerate your career.

- Work That Matters – We protect the world's most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.

- Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.

- Financial Rewards – We hire the best and invest in you. Competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

Location: In-office, NYC HQ. This role works daily across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Ops, and client-facing executives, so we've built it to be in-person.

About The Role

We're looking for an exceptional field marketer to build a high-impact field marketing engine at WithCoverage.

You'll turn our priority markets, verticals, and accounts into focused programs that create executive relationships and pipeline. The canvas includes intimate dinners and roundtables, conferences, partner programs, regional campaigns, customer moments, and new formats we haven't thought of yet.

You'll own the full program—from market and account strategy through concept, audience development, execution, sales follow-up, and measurement.

You might come from field marketing, integrated marketing, demand generation, growth, partnerships, or another commercial marketing discipline. What matters is that you're an unusually strong marketer who can turn a blank page into programs that sales teams value, executives want to attend, and prospects remember.

What You'll Do

- Build the field marketing engine from zero. Translate priority regions, verticals, and accounts into programs that create demand and generate pipeline.

- Develop market plans. Partner with Sales and RevOps on target accounts, audience segments, campaign plays, goals, and measurement.

- Create programs people want to join. Own dinners, roundtables, conferences, partner activations, customer moments, and other high-touch experiences.

- Get the right people in the room. Drive audience acquisition across sales, partner, customer, and owned channels.

- Turn engagement into pipeline. Build tight sales follow-up, account progression, attribution, and conversion systems.

- Test and scale. Stay hands-on, learn quickly from performance, and turn the strongest plays into a repeatable field marketing motion.

Who You Are

- Exceptionally smart, driven, resourceful, and commercially minded.

- Strong strategic instincts across markets, accounts, audiences, and messaging.

- A zero-to-one builder who can move from market insight to a polished program quickly.

- Motivated by pipeline, account progression, and measurable revenue impact.

- A strong communicator with the executive presence to work with senior leaders, customers, partners, and speakers.

- High ownership, high velocity, and comfortable operating without a large team or established playbook.

- Analytical and operational enough to measure performance, learn quickly, and improve the model.

For candidates based in the United States, the expected OTE pay range for this position at the start of employment is $140,000 – $170,000/year. Actual compensation will vary based on individual factors, including market location, relevant experience, and role scope. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable compensation tied to performance or quota attainment, where applicable. WithCoverage’s Total Rewards package for full-time employees also includes equity participation and comprehensive benefits. If you’re excited about the role but your compensation expectations are outside this range, we’d still love to hear from you; final offers reflect experience, scope, and leveling.

What We Offer:

- Competitive compensation that includes equity

- Comprehensive benefit plans for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

- Pre-tax accounts (FSA, HSAs, dependent care FSAs, commuter savings)

- Human Interest: 401(k) provider

- Time Off: Flexible time off, sick leave, family and medical leave, and major national holidays

- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture

Location: New York, NY

About The Role:

Join WithCoverage as VP, Growth on the Growth team, based in our NYC office. This is a specialist role: you will be the subject matter expert for a specific vertical, such as Private Equity, Real Estate, Consumer/CPG, Technology, or Manufacturing, and own new business growth within it.

The VP, Growth will be responsible for converting and closing new mid-market accounts in your vertical, onboarding new clients, identifying and addressing industry-specific needs, and developing strong client relationships. You will bring a point of view on how risk shows up in your industry and help shape how WithCoverage goes to market there.

This role requires close collaboration with the BDR and Risk Management teams throughout the full sales funnel. It is a sales-driven, quota-carrying role where you'll drive growth of the vertical across the full conversion cycle, build deep industry relationships, and lead all aspects of deal execution. We're looking for someone who wants ownership, thrives in high-performance environments, and is eager to accelerate their career by building something meaningful.

What You’ll Do:

- Own the full cycle (discovery → close) within your vertical, partnering closely with top of funnel teams to qualify opportunities and a Risk Management Advisor to drive deals forward with urgency and precision

- Own deep, consultative discovery that goes beyond surface-level needs: diagnosing operational challenges, key risk management exposures, and partnering to form a risk mitigation plan that earns trust and drives conviction

- Lead onboarding for new accounts and set the foundation for long-term success by aligning expectations, mapping timelines, and building trust early

- Nurture and manage your pipeline by proactively sourcing and engaging new prospects through outbound efforts, warm intros, referrals, and strategic networking within your industry

- Develop compelling proposals and deal narratives that communicate value, anticipate objections, and move decision-makers toward action

Who You Are:

- 8+ years of experience in a Enterprise consultative sales OR commercial insurance Producer (or AVP/VP) role with quota-tied responsibility, including prospecting, discovery, and conversion

- Deep expertise in a specific vertical (e.g. Private Equity, Real Estate, Consumer/CPG, Technology, Data Centers, or Manufacturing), with a book or track record of placing business in that space

- Fluency in the coverage lines, carrier markets, and risk exposures that matter most to your industry

- An established network of industry relationships you can activate for referrals and warm introductions

- Strong client relationship management and consultative sales skills

- Excellent executive communication and presentation skills

- Ambitious and motivated by fast-paced professional environments

- Able to work collaboratively in a team environment

For candidates based in the United States, the expected OTE pay range for this position at the start of employment is $250,000 – $300,000/year. Actual compensation will vary based on individual factors, including market location, relevant experience, and role scope. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable compensation tied to performance or quota attainment, where applicable. WithCoverage’s Total Rewards package for full-time employees also includes equity participation and comprehensive benefits.
